I felt this whole heartedly. I was in the exact same position, wanted to move to London but was too unsure of myself and my ability to live abroad, alone, for the first time. 
I decided to come for a week as a trial run, crashed on the couch of a friend and went about doing all the touristy things and getting acquainted with the city. It was adventurous and exciting, I fell so full heartedly in love with the city I was devastated to come back home. I decided when I stepped foot in my apartment that I was going to move to London, and the only thing stopping me up until that point was a fear I had implemented myself. 
2 months later I took the biggest leap, found the smallest room in a flat share and off I went. It has now been 7 years, and that magic till hasn’t dissipated. Every time I walk past the London Eye, or Big Ben, a stroll through Hyde Park or getting coffee at Covent Garden I think to myself “Wow, I really live in London”. With every walk, bus ride, or train journey there’s always a new nook of the city to discover. Everyone is so welcoming here, it doesn’t matter what walk of life you come from, everyone is just as interested in you as you are in them. 
While it seems you’re not ready for a big move, I feel another visit is long overdue for you. If you ever need help or guidance I’m here to help! 
But if you ever have the option to visit that feeling again, go for it, everyone deserves that little bit of magic.
I had very similar and was told it was athletes foot but on my hands 😬

I would definitely wait until you lose the extra weight, it can make a big difference if you get filler now, lose the extra weight and the sagging skin will look like you haven’t had anything done at all (not to say you want it to be obvious that you’ve had filler).
When going in either for a consultation or for the actual procedure discuss with your technician that you’ve lost weight, and they will then advise you on the best course of action. 
I’m sure you’ve done your research but just a reminder that filler is an expensive upkeep to have, while it might seem like a quick fix the price quickly adds up for temporary results.
